criterion_text: On a supported Linux Agent, Enter with a managed Workspace selection resolves/creates exactly one stable Workspace, acquires its RW lease, binds that durable directory at `/workspace`, and reports the effective policy; execution cleanup releases the lease, leaves the bytes intact, and a second attachment observes the same content. A missing directory, a lease conflict, an unsupported Project Location/lower combination, or an unavailable registry refuses preparation with no Native fallback.

verifiers.summary: One stable managed Workspace is prepared and leased for /workspace; unsupported combinations fail closed and durable bytes survive while deletion requires no attachment

evidence.value: exact SHA 5f4485152c547a23841cab151d6d58d8fb42d86e: concurrent get-or-create returned one stable id; a manager restart reused the same id and bytes; a missing directory stayed missing; delete was refused while leased and removed only an unleased workspace; a symlinked path was refused; the selected managed directory replaced the execution scratch write target and the unsupported Project-lower combination was refused
